def process(reportType, identityTheftByType):
    import pandas as pd

    # ---- Denominator: total # of reports (all report types) ----
    rt = reportType.copy()
    rt = rt.rename(columns={rt.columns[0]: 'report_type', rt.columns[1]: 'num_reports_raw'})

    # Keep rows that look like actual report type entries with a numeric count
    rt = rt[rt['report_type'].notna() & rt['num_reports_raw'].notna()]
    rt['num_reports'] = (
        rt['num_reports_raw']
        .astype(str)
        .str.replace(',', '', regex=False)
        .str.extract(r'(\d+)', expand=False)
        .astype('float')
    )

    total_all_reports = rt['num_reports'].sum()

    # ---- Numerator: identity theft reports with Theft Type=Bank Account & Theft Subtype=New Accounts ----
    it = identityTheftByType.copy()
    it = it.rename(columns={it.columns[0]: 'theft_type', it.columns[1]: 'theft_subtype', it.columns[2]: 'num_reports_raw'})
    it = it[it['theft_type'].notna() & it['theft_subtype'].notna() & it['num_reports_raw'].notna()]

    it['num_reports'] = (
        it['num_reports_raw']
        .astype(str)
        .str.replace(',', '', regex=False)
        .str.extract(r'(\d+)', expand=False)
        .astype('float')
    )

    mask = (it['theft_type'].str.strip().str.casefold() == 'bank account') & (
        it['theft_subtype'].str.strip().str.casefold() == 'new accounts'
    )
    num = it.loc[mask, 'num_reports'].sum()

    prop = num / total_all_reports if total_all_reports else float('nan')

    return pd.DataFrame([
        {
            'numerator_reports_bank_account_new_accounts': num,
            'denominator_total_all_reports': total_all_reports,
            'proportion': prop,
            'proportion_rounded_4dp': round(prop, 4) if pd.notna(prop) else None,
        }
    ])
